**Changelog for alibabacloud-polardbx-ai-assistant v0.0.2**

- Increased minimal aliyun CLI version to 3.3.3 and updated installation instructions.
- Enforced required use of AI-mode for all CLI operations, including user-agent header and AI-mode lifecycle management (enable before, disable after).
- Added explicit instructions to always update CLI plugins with `aliyun plugin update`.
- Updated documentation and workflow scripts to reflect stricter user-agent and AI-mode requirements.
- General documentation improvements and clarifications in installation and operation steps.

Initial release of Alibaba Cloud PolarDB-X Distributed Database AI Assistant.

- Provides intelligent O&M for PolarDB-X clusters via the aliyun CLI DAS plugin (get-yao-chi-agent API).
- Supports cluster management, topology inspection, performance diagnostics, SQL optimization, security audits, backup checks, parameter tuning, and more.
- Enforces strict credential handling and permission checks—never print or request AK/SK.
- All O&M actions routed through scripts/call_yaochi_agent.sh, never using direct polardbx/rds APIs.
- Includes detailed installation, configuration, and permission guidance to ensure secure and proper usage.
